results.title: Rasmus Hojlund Sparks Chaos Against Portugal With Cristiano Ronaldo's 'Siu' Celebration And Post-Match Jorge Jesus Clash | Video
results.description: Rasmus Hojlund became a talking point after celebrating his goal against Portugal with Cristiano Ronaldo’s iconic “Siuuu” celebration. Portugal eventually won 4-2. After the match, footage appeared to show Hojlund briefly making contact with coach Jorge Jesus, though the reason remains unconfirmed. Hojlund’s Ronaldo-inspired celebration and the post-match moment added drama to the encounter.
